passives.name: Let Me Pray!
passives.description: (Passive) Each turn, SPD increases by [Buff_V_tower_apc_35_1_6] (up to 20 stacks). Reduces damage taken from attacks by 100% and takes 60% of damage dealt to Faenan instead. When an ally dies, enemies take increased damage by [Buff_V_tower_apc_35_2_1] (up to 10 stacks). Marks the front ally with Mark for [Buff_T_tower_apc_35_1_6_2] turns.
